about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: AE Plumbing has been serving Wolverhampton and the surrounding West Midlands for nearly two decades. Founded on the principle that honest work at a fair price keeps customers coming back, we've built our reputation one satisfied household at a time. We're Gas Safe registered and carry all parts on the van — so most repairs are done the same day you call.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we turn up when we say we will, explain what's wrong in plain English, and don't recommend work you don't need. We're local, we answer our phones, and we guarantee our labour. That's why over 80% of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Boiler packed in mid-January and I panicked — Steve answered the phone straight away and was here within the hour. He fitted a new one the very next day and explained everything clearly. No hidden charges, no messing about. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a leaking radiator just before Christmas. Called in desperation and AE Plumbing picked up immediately. Got an appointment same day, chap was polite and professional, sorted it in less than an hour. Reasonable price too. Top marks.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Second time I've used them in three years. Both times they've been reliable, competent, and fair on cost. They actually listen when you explain what's wrong instead of pushing you into unnecessary work. Highly recommended to anyone in the area.
reviews.author: David K.
